metadata.title: Vintage Soul Portrait with Swash Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A close-up studio portrait featuring a subject with an afro and high-collared dark clothing, paired with decorative swash-heavy serif typography in the upper left corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, warm-toned portrait of a woman with a large afro hairstyle, wearing a black high-collared shirt. The lighting is soft and directional, highlighting the face against a dark, textured background. Decorative, interlocking serif text with dramatic swashes is positioned in the top left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face as the primary focal point
Typography nested in the negative space of the hair and background
Warm skin tones contrasting with deep black clothing
coreInvariants: Large afro hairstyle framing the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered and fills approximately 70% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright red-orange lips.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face to the decorative text in the top left, then down the line of the collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the background and the dark fabric of the shirt provide negative space for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark browns in the clothing and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and golden highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red-orange on the lips and pink/gold in the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the face and the dark surroundings; high saturation in the lip color.

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing with occasional overlaps
Varying stroke weights with thin hairlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'B' and 'M' feature extended, curling swashes
Lowercase 'y' and 'g' have decorative looped tails

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the dark background/hair area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative family with varying weights and swash alternates.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s decorative serif aesthetic perfectly.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm-toned studio portrait of a woman with a large afro, wearing a black high-collared shirt against a dark, slightly textured background. Focus on soft directional lighting on the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply decorative serif text in the top left corner using a font with heavy swashes. Use gold and pink colors for the text, ensuring it interlocks elegantly.

verificationChecks: Ensure the afro hairstyle is prominent

mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital sharpness; maintain a film-like grain
Ensure swashes do not obscure the subject's eyes
postGenerationChecks: Is the typography in the top left quadrant?
Does the subject have a large afro?
Is the lighting warm and directional?
Are the swashes on the text prominent?
Is the collar high and dark?
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait(Afro + High Collar + Warm Light) + Typography(Swash Serif + Top Left Placement)
